description: This file contains utility shell functions for system management tasks including logging, reboot handling, retrieving system uptime, network configurations, and core dump management.

methods.name: Timestamp
methods.description: Returns the current timestamp formatted as 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS'.

methods.name: resetRebootFlag
methods.description: Logs a reboot event and resets the reboot flag in the filesystem.

methods.name: getIPAddress
methods.description: Obtains the IP address of the device, supporting IPv6 if available.

methods.name: getMacAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the MAC address of the specified interface.

methods.name: getMacAddressOnly
methods.description: Retrieves the MAC address stripped of colons.

methods.name: waitForDumpCompletion
methods.description: Waits for core dump to complete, with a timeout.

methods.name: dumpInProcess
methods.description: Checks if a core dump process is currently running.

methods.name: haveCoreToUpload
methods.description: Checks if there are core dumps available for upload.
